2610.09107.title: Constraint Tree Exploration for Learning from Language Feedback
2610.09107.paper_summary: Natural-language feedback in interactive learning often explains why an action failed by pointing to violated requirements. Misinterpreting this feedback can lead an agent to rule out valid solutions. We study this setting by modeling user intent as latent constraints over an action space and formulating learning from language feedback as pure exploration over feasible regions. We introduce TRACE, an algorithm that organizes candidate constraints in a tree and tests each proposed refinement by generating actions that satisfy it. TRACE commits to the refinement only if the resulting feedback does not contradict it over repeated tests. We distinguish two ways of using the same feedback: (i) falsification, which detects contradictions to the constraint set currently being tested, and (ii) identification, which may additionally name a violated constraint. We prove high-probability coverage bounds with dependence on the candidate class size $H$ for TRACE-Falsification. With reliable identification, TRACE-Identification can replace this dependence by $K/p_{\mathrm{ext}}$, where $K$ is the number of latent constraints and $p_{\mathrm{ext}}$ lower-bounds the probability of extracting a missing true constraint from informative feedback. We evaluate TRACE across six language-feedback tasks. On RecMovie, TRACE-Identification achieves 73% and 86% final-output success under caps of 20 and 60 evaluated outputs, compared with at most 42% and 48% for the evaluated prompting baselines given the same feedback and output caps. Controlled identity-corruption experiments further show greater robustness than direct accumulation when the falsification detector remains reliable.
2610.09107.paper_summary_zh: 自然語言反饋在互動學習中通常解釋了為什麼某個行動失敗，並指出違反的要求。對這些反饋的誤解可能會導致代理排除有效的解決方案。我們通過將用戶意圖建模為行動空間上的潛在約束來研究這種情況，並將從語言反饋中學習的過程表述為對可行區域的純探索。我們引入了 TRACE，一種將候選約束組織成樹狀結構的算法，並通過生成滿足每個提議的改進的行動來測試它。TRACE 只有在重複測試中結果反饋不與之矛盾時，才會承諾這一改進。我們區分了使用相同反饋的兩種方式：（i）偽證，檢測當前正在測試的約束集的矛盾，以及（ii）識別，這可能額外命名一個違反的約束。我們證明了 TRACE-Falsification 的高概率覆蓋界限，並依賴於候選類大小 $H$。在可靠識別的情況下，TRACE-Identification 可以用 $K/p_{\mathrm{ext}}$ 來替代這一依賴，其中 $K$ 是潛在約束的數量，$p_{\mathrm{ext}}$ 是從信息反饋中提取缺失真約束的概率的下界。我們在六個語言反饋任務中評估了 TRACE。在 RecMovie 上，TRACE-Identification 在 20 和 60 個評估輸出上，最終輸出成功率分別達到 73% 和 86%，而在相同反饋和輸出上限下，評估的提示基線最多僅達到 42% 和 48%。控制身份腐敗實驗進一步顯示，當偽證檢測器保持可靠時，其穩健性優於直接累積。
